findings.message: Replacing notes with the address book’s own read-only view silently deletes every note. getNoteMap() returns Collections.unmodifiableMap(notes), a live view. Calling setNotes(book.getNoteMap()), resetData(book), or model.setAddressBook(model.getAddressBook()) reaches this.notes.clear() before putAll(notes), so the source map is already empty.

The user guide incorrectly says notes are neither persisted nor undoable. Lines 335 and 360 describe confirmation-only behavior and explicitly deny undo support. NoteCommand.execute now calls model.setNote(), isStateMutating() returns true, and LogicManager saves the address book after execution; JsonSerializableAddressBook now serializes notes.
